let configObj = try TreeSitterLanguagePack.processConfigFromJson("{\"docstrings\":true,\"language\":\"python\"}")
let result = try TreeSitterLanguagePack.process(source: "def greet(name):\n    \"\"\"Say hello to someone.\"\"\"\n    return f\"Hello {name}\"\n", config: configObj)
